<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';

  if (window.__RS_PAGE_RUNTIME_V1__) return;
  window.__RS_PAGE_RUNTIME_V1__ = true;

  var CONTENT_ENDPOINT = '/test/rs-dynamic-section/content';

  function setBlockEnabled(block, enabled) {
    block.hidden = !enabled;
    block.setAttribute('aria-hidden', enabled ? 'false' : 'true');

    if (enabled) {
      block.removeAttribute('inert');
    } else {
      block.setAttribute('inert', '');
    }
  }

  function slotMap(block) {
    var map = Object.create(null);

    Array.prototype.forEach.call(block.querySelectorAll('[data-rs-value]'), function (slot) {
      var key = String(slot.getAttribute('data-rs-value') || '').trim();
      if (!key) return;
      if (!map[key]) map[key] = [];
      map[key].push(slot);
    });

    return map;
  }

  function applyPayload(block, payload) {
    if (!payload || payload.ok !== true || !payload.tree) {
      throw new Error((payload && (payload.error || payload.detail)) || 'dynamic_content_invalid');
    }

    var slots = slotMap(block);
    var updated = 0;

    (payload.tree.divs || []).forEach(function (div) {
      (div.typography || []).forEach(function (typeRow) {
        var contentRow = (typeRow.content || [])[0];
        if (!contentRow) return;

        var key = String(typeRow.data_rs_value || contentRow.data_rs_value || '').trim();
        var targets = slots[key] || [];
        if (!key || !targets.length) return;

        targets.forEach(function (target) {
          target.textContent = String(contentRow.content_value == null ? '' : contentRow.content_value);
          updated += 1;
        });
      });
    });

    return updated;
  }

  function loadDynamicBlock(pageKey, block) {
    var blockKey = String(block.getAttribute('data-rs-block') || '').trim();
    if (!blockKey) return Promise.resolve();

    var url = new URL(CONTENT_ENDPOINT, window.location.origin);
    url.searchParams.set('pageKey', pageKey);
    url.searchParams.set('blockKey', blockKey);
    url.searchParams.set('_', Date.now());

    block.setAttribute('data-rs-content-status', 'loading');

    return fetch(url.toString(), {
      cache: 'no-store',
      headers: { Accept: 'application/json' }
    })
      .then(function (response) {
        if (!response.ok) throw new Error('dynamic_content_http_' + response.status);
        return response.json();
      })
      .then(function (payload) {
        var updated = applyPayload(block, payload);
        block.setAttribute('data-rs-content-status', 'ready');
        block.setAttribute('data-rs-content-updated', String(updated));
        block.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('rs:dynamic-content-ready', {
          bubbles: true,
          detail: { pageKey: pageKey, blockKey: blockKey, updated: updated }
        }));
      })
      .catch(function (error) {
        block.setAttribute('data-rs-content-status', 'failed');
        console.error('[rs-page-runtime]', pageKey + '/' + blockKey, error);
      });
  }

  function start() {
    var page = document.querySelector('[data-rs-page]');
    if (!page) return;

    var pageKey = String(page.getAttribute('data-rs-page') || '').trim();
    if (!pageKey) return;

    var dynamicLoads = [];

    Array.prototype.forEach.call(page.querySelectorAll('[data-rs-block]'), function (block) {
      var enabled = block.getAttribute('data-rs-enabled') !== 'false';
      var delivery = block.getAttribute('data-rs-delivery') || 'static_seed';

      setBlockEnabled(block, enabled);

      if (enabled && delivery === 'dynamic_runtime') {
        dynamicLoads.push(loadDynamicBlock(pageKey, block));
      }
    });

    Promise.all(dynamicLoads).then(function () {
      page.setAttribute('data-rs-runtime-status', 'ready');
      page.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('rs:page-runtime-ready', {
        bubbles: true,
        detail: { pageKey: pageKey, dynamicBlocks: dynamicLoads.length }
      }));
    });
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', start, { once: true });
  } else {
    start();
  }
})();
</script>
